description: Every active student with the anamnesis (health questionnaire) status: pending (sent, not answered, not expired; waiting_days and expires_at), answered (last_submitted_at) or never_sent (never received one, or it expired unanswered). Each row has name, phone to reach out (the guardian's for a dependent) and app_url: the student profile, or the answer already open when answered. status filters one group: status=pending answers "who has not answered the anamnesis yet?", longest wait first; status=never_sent lists who still needs send_anamnesis. Next: list_anamnesis_answers to read one, or send_anamnesis. Read only: nothing is sent to the student.

status.description: Only one group: pending, answered or never_sent. Default all.

name: get_anamnesis_overview
title: See anamnesis status
